name: Apex V1 public proposals with realized official terminal pair supervision
source_notice: Teacher policy and critic embedded text match Master3s2 exactly. Do not imitate its decisions or train on its logits/values. Evaluate only its proposals. Student receives realized native paired official score preference; Apex used solely to double the training weight on actual alternative nominations.
source_panels: Eight completed tree_response_training original responder batches, 8 registered one-worker pairs on 2 maps each. Training batches 1..6: 48 roots/12 maps. Frozen held batches 7 and 8:16 roots/4 other maps. Both cohorts are previously seen development evidence and excluded from formal exam. No selection by score; unequal/unrepresentable interventions are reported.
student: Genuine bare 1,206,476 parameter master6_actor_v1.npz f82bfd47a904aa1fbfa4e95fbfcdd13e623c1f1eb216a8e736694a1d282cc713. Frozen encoder. Only autoregressive decoder and classification heads updated. Export standalone policy without any teacher source, parameters, runtime or proposer bits.
method: Use focal seat public observation history and own earlier recorded baseline slots. Compare two registered commands that differ only for focal worker under identical prefix. Targets are the official terminal margin ordering of two complete native continuations with shared initial enemy action and identical source continuation protocol; no teacher moves or scores are targets. Equal cash ties <=0.01 excluded. One stochastic continuation per arm. All full teacher commands retained for coverage and prefix-legal audit only.
arms: Outcome control and proposal-weighted treatment use identical fixed parent, 32 minibatches of 8 cycled roots, RNG620244, AdamW lr=0.00008. Pair logistic loss with parent-forward KL on logged public positions weighted 0.35, role prior unmodified. Treatment scale 2 if the independently obtained Apex focal action equals registered alternative; otherwise 1. Normalize by minibatch sum.
gate: Development screening only. On 4 held maps under q8 encoding compare realized constrained choice regret per map. Treatment must improve mean vs frozen parent AND matched control, improve vs parent on at least 3 maps, emit a different conditional pair choice from control at >=2 held roots. If any fail, no native job. Full pure-policy joint matches must be reported before claiming transfer to a deployed actor. No new original opponent games in this packet.
